name: @penguinharness/sandbox-win
description: Windows sandbox backend for PenguinHarness: commands run under a write-restricted token, so a Win64 toolchain builds in the Workspace and writes nowhere else.

scripts.build: node ../../scripts/gen-ifaces.mjs --project tsconfig.json --out ifaces.json && tsup && tsup --config tsup.launcher.config.ts

penguin.description_zh: PenguinHarness 的 Windows 原生沙箱后端：命令以「写受限令牌」运行，Win64 工具链可在工作区内编译，工作区之外一处也写不进。
penguin.short_description: Windows: build Win64 apps confined by a write-restricted token.
penguin.short_description_zh: Windows：以写受限令牌运行命令，可编译 Win64 应用。
penguin.title: Windows Sandbox
